sources.title: Formation and development of ventilated supercavity past the disk-cavitator in accelerated motion
sources.authors: V. Moroz; V. Kochin; V. Semenenko; O. Naumova
sources.read_depth: Full main text sections 1-8, equations 1-12, tables 1-2; rendered printed p.168 inspected.

Model retains portion-type air loss through acceleration, then switches after a delay. Prescribed near-constant pressure replaces gas-mass balance to avoid unsupported oscillations at low velocity.

sources.title: Dynamics of supercavitating vehicles with cone cavitators
sources.authors: V. Semenenko; V. Moroz; V. Kochin; O. Naumova
sources.read_depth: Targeted main-text review: experiment, force laws, equivalent disk, model architecture and selected balancing/control cases. Printed p.87 rendered for polynomial sign. Not every control simulation independently reproduced.
sources.evidence: 50 mm cavitators at full cone angles 40,60,120 degrees plus disk. Printed cubic Eq.2 has a positive cubic term inconsistent with its Figure 5 and the later 2024 negative-cubic formula. Use 2024 Eq.23 explicitly rather than silently editing the earlier formula.

sources.title: Prediction of the unsteady ventilated partial cavities
sources.read_depth: Targeted full-text review of formulation, discretization, comparison and conclusions; not all equations visually rechecked.
sources.evidence: Two distinct methods: planar slender wedge on a wall uses linear potential flow and discrete singularities; ring flange on a cylinder uses independent cavity-section expansion. Planar model fails to generate known ventilation instability, explicitly acknowledged by authors. These are partial cavities, not a drop-in fully enclosing cone-supercavity model.
sources.code_status: Algorithm/discretization published; no reusable public source code located.
sources.access: Publisher full PDF retrieved and text extracted on 2026-11-01

sources.title: Experimental study and computer simulation of dynamics of supercavitating bodies penetrating water at small angles to the free surface
sources.authors: Yu. M. Savchenko; V. M. Semenenko; G. Yu. Savchenko; O. I. Naumova
sources.read_depth: English landing abstract plus targeted Ukrainian full text: sections 4.1-5,6.3-6.5,7; key source pages 88-90 rendered. This is not a complete independently checked translation.
sources.evidence: Free-flight water entry: 10-25 m/s, angles 4-15 degrees, video 1000 fps. Free-surface correction has fitted Ks, depth clamped below 2 cavitator diameters. Authors report Fortran DIVE_16.2 and DIVE_52. Splash/surface closure, atmospheric breakthrough and underwater tumbling lie outside stated approximation.
sources.code_status: Fortran language and program names established from section 5; no public repository, source package, downloadable executable or reproducible runtime found.

implemented_on_new_page: Exact finite-station paper-data overlays: 2024 cone diameter, 2023 disk diameter and axis rise.
Independent implementation of 2024 Eqs.22-23 for signed cone lift slope and coefficient; radians used for inclination, degrees for cone half-angle.
Recomputed finite-sample profile errors; no CFD or 6-DOF trajectory simulation.
not_implemented: Gas mass balance and physical gas-loss transition
Free-surface water-entry dynamics, fitted Ks correction, ricochet map
Any hardware-scale extrapolation or new scientific simulation

formulas.units: f in 1/rad; gamma degrees; delta radians
formulas.validation: Published Table4 samples: (20,0.8354),(30,0.4950),(60,-0.4060); Table3 disk slope -0.7890. Polynomial is a fit, not exact interpolation. Predicted slopes 0.87368,0.44852,-0.39304,-0.79036 at 20,30,60,90 degrees.
formulas.limitation: Experiments concentrated near sigma 0.03-0.04; inclination small (Eq22 |delta|<20 degrees). Slider is an algebraic illustration.

formulas.domain: 15 <= gamma_deg <= 90; sigma <=0.25; add viscous term cf/sin(gamma) in Eq15 and inclination correction Eq24 only with consistent sign conventions.
Slender cavity, A approximately2, kappa0.9-1.0; forward-section matching differs for sharp cones.

formulas.expression: Cavity section history plus gas-volume/pressure balance; modified acceleration model prescribes pressure instead of Eq12.
formulas.limitation: Do not claim the prescribed-pressure adaptation predicts ventilation stability or initial nucleation from rest.

formulas.expression: Free-surface displacement proportional to sqrt(sigma)*x*(Lc-x)/(4*A*H*Ks), with H clamped at2*Dn.
formulas.limitation: Ks is calibrated: approximately1.5-2 for steady/unsteady travel and exit;2-3 for shallow-angle entry. Formula/source notation requires a separate dimensional/sign review before implementation.

cone2024.coverage: Only listed axial stations; cavity closure is not sampled.
cone2024.note: Both curves are paper data. No present project solver prediction is included; percent differences recomputed from diameters rather than copied from printed percentage column.

disk2023.note: The paper assumes circular sections through the tail; actual steady tail becomes elliptical/twin-vortex. This explains growing downstream profile mismatch. Do not relabel its paper calculation as a new prediction.

source_discrepancies.finding: Positive cubic term +2.05e-7*beta^3 gives +1.60076 at beta180; its own graph has a negative disk endpoint. Later2024 Eq23 uses negative cubic and gives -0.79036. Not silently corrected.
Text drops negative sign for disk endpoint, while Table3/Fig4/Eq23 consistently show negative. Page uses signed table/formula values.
Some percentages differ from arithmetic on rounded diameters; page recomputes and labels its own metrics.
